llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D生物打印技术制造水凝胶支架用于毛囊再生，但未涉及任何人工智能方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses solely on bioprinting a hydrogel for tissue regeneration without incorporating any AI or machine learning method, so it does not address AI integration in bioprinting workflows.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可打印的水凝胶支架促进毛囊再生
summary_zh.method: 使用明胶-海藻酸钠水凝胶进行3D生物打印构建毛囊再生支架
summary_zh.result: 支架支持细胞增殖和毛囊样结构形成
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证生物相容性和再生能力

summary_en.motivation: To develop a printable hydrogel scaffold that can support hair follicle regeneration.
summary_en.method: 3D bioprinting of a gelatin-alginate hydrogel to fabricate scaffolds for tissue-engineered hair follicle regeneration.
summary_en.result: The bioprinted scaffolds promoted cell proliferation and formation of hair follicle-like structures in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments demonstrated biocompatibility and regenerative potential.
